note: Alberta Parks recreation area and staging area for Whitehorse Wildland Provincial Park, ~6 km SW of Cadomin on a gravel access road, along Whitehorse Creek near its confluence with the McLeod River. The nine equestrian sites (corrals, pens, tie stalls, loading ramp) are only for parties with horses. Free firewood. Operated by West Fraser Mills with the Fox Creek Development Association. --Claude
